papers.title: STISA: A 0.16 GOPS/W/PE Single-Shot Inference FPGA-based SNN Accelerator with Algorithm and Hardware Co-Design
authors: Kainan Wang, Chengyi Yang, Lei Liu, Chengting Yu, Yee Sin Ang, Bo Wang, Aili Wang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19973v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer great potential for low-power intelligent computing owing to their event-driven nature, yet their deployment is limited by high inference latency and inefficient hardware utilization caused by temporal dependencies. papers.title: ESL-former: Event Sparse Linear Transformer for FPGA-Accelerated Malware Detection
authors: Jun Yang, Yumeng Cao, Yingxuan Xiao, Changhong Li, Shangru Zhou
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19665v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Transformer based intrusion detection has shown strong potential for identifying unknown malware variants, but its deployment on resource constrained edge devices remains difficult due to the high computational and memory cost of self attention. This paper presents an event sparse Linear Transformer framework for malware detection on FPGA edge platforms. Instead of relying on an explicit attention matrix, the proposed method derives token and channel importance directly from the accumulated key value state of Linear Transformer. papers.title: O-SCOPE: a Raspberry Pi Pico oscilloscope
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18906v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this paper we provide an introduction to some of the efficient features of the Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2) family of microconroller boards (RP2040 and RP2350). More exactly, we show how to use PIO (Programmable Input/Output) and DMA (Direct Memory Access) to program the RP2 boards for efficient DAC (Digital to Analog) and ADC (Analog to Digital) conversions. Using OP-AMPS (Operational Amplifiers) we also show how to build a minimal electronic frontend interface for signal input/output. Finally, we integrate all these components into a product, the O-SCOPE, which is a practical and easy to use oscilloscope and wave function generator.
